activity_event_types.why: The activity taxonomy (1060): which event types exist, their category, default visibility and severity, and which an external worker may report. One vocabulary for every office; a per-office copy would let an office widen what a diagnostic type may show.

activity_events.why: Native activity with no other home (1060). office_id is written with the row and is its owner; the project, job and parent job are tied to it by same-office composite keys, so a native event cannot point into another office.

project_restores.why: One row per archive restored into an office (1071), keyed by the archive's SHA-256, so a repeat of the same archive returns the first project and writes nothing. It names its office; project_id is the project the restore created, and the composite key to projects keeps it in that office.
